title: GUM eRST relation to provisional paragraph function crosswalk
definition_basis: Zeldes et al. 2025 eRST, Table A.12 printed page 64; relation inventory checked in pinned GUM RS4. S=satellite; N=nucleus; nuclei may be full spans, not just paragraphs. Definitions paraphrased.

mapping_kind_definitions.conditional: A function is a possible hypothesis only after the stated contextual condition is independently assessed.
mapping_kind_definitions.partial: A relation resembles a specific aspect of a function but does not establish the whole function, quality, or paragraph span.
mapping_kind_definitions.relation_only: Useful link or structural relation with no justified direct role mapping.
mapping_kind_definitions.none: No justified direct mapping in this catalogue.

deterministic_checks_shared: Read declared original relation and resolve graph IDs and both spans, including multinuclear groups.
Preserve N/S or equal-nucleus roles, full scope, ordering and primary versus secondary edge; retain same-unit discontinuities.
If independently token-aligned to XML, report paragraph overlap and unresolved or cross-paragraph spans; do not infer function validity.
